capabilities: Open sticky-note popout windows from ribbon, command, or context menus
Pin windows to stay on top
Configure default size, pin mode, and workspace saving
Destroy all sticky notes with one command
disambiguation: Not a note-taking or annotation tool; it only opens existing Obsidian popouts as small sticky-note-style windows.
extras: Manual install via zip from releases. README warns to back up notes and notes the plugin depends on @electron/remote and on Obsidian's internal CSS class names, which may break in future releases.
intentEvidence: builds on top of the existing popout functionality of obsidian
problem: Obsidian's popout windows are full editor windows, too heavy for quick, always-on-top scratch notes.
summary: Sticky-note popout windows that open on top of Obsidian with pinning, resizing, and background color options.
